Hi Zwifters,

Zwift will perform scheduled maintenance starting on Monday March 20 @ 02:00 UTC in order to upgrade our system performance and stability.

This update will take approximately 4 hours.

Zwifter impacts:

Zwifters will not be able to log in to the game app.
a. If you are logged in to the game before the maintenance window, you can continue to ride/run, but you will not be able to:
b. Join an Event.
c. See newly completed activities.
d. Give Ride Ons.

You will not be able to log in to zwift.com websites including the Zwift Forums, ZwiftPower.com and the Zwift Shop.

You will not be able to create new Zwift accounts.

The Zwift Companion app will show a maintenance page.

Zwift Power will process event results after a delay that may last several hours.

Zwift Forums will be available in read-only mode for those who are not already logged in.

Third party sync to Strava, Training Peaks, Today’s Plan and others will be delayed by several hours.

As this is a significant amount of downtime, we are alerting you in advance, so you can plan accordingly.

Maintenance Schedule
Monday March 20 @ 02:00 - 06:00 UTC.
Tokyo [JST]: Monday March 20 @ 11:00 am - 03:00 pm
Sydney [AEDT]: Monday March 20 @ 1:00 pm - 5:00 pm
Rio de Janeiro [UTC-3]: Sunday March 19 @ 11:00 pm - 3:00 pm
New York [EDT] Sunday March 19 @ 10:00 pm - Monday March 20 @ 02:00 am
Los Angeles [PDT]: Sunday March 19 @ 7:00pm - 11:00 pm
Use this site 1.3k to convert to your local time zone.

Status updates will be provided on our Status Page which will maintain normal operations.

We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience. We will work quickly to get Zwift back up and running…and get you back to riding and running.

Ride On,

Zwift
